column3: Settled behind the front group - driven to gain ground with a furlong left - edged in front approaching the last furlong - kept up the effort to score
Well placed early - given a squeeze approaching 2f out - stayed on to loom up with a shout 1f out - unable to find more in final furlong
Sat close to the early duo - edged onto the pace approaching the furlong marker - couldn't quicken 110 yards out and finished third
Held up at the back - driven approaching final furlong and hampered for room - unable to peg back deficit before the line finished 4th
Set the pace early - driven to keep advantage 2f out - overtaken close to final furlong - dropped away late to finish 5th
Held up towards back - driven approaching final furlong - weakened late - finished sixth
Sat close to the front - edged in front just past 2f out - driven out approaching the final furlong - kept finding under late pressure to prevail
Slow to break - settled towards the back - driven into contention with two furlongs left - into second inside the final furlong but unable to reel in the winner
Slow to break - settled just off midfield - urged forward before 3f out - moved into fourth 2f out - lost a little ground briefly - responded to the whip and stuck on for third
Settled just off the pack early - into a forward position by the 4f mark - urged for effort 2f out and kept going at an even tempo to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - found space and moved through inside the final furlong - stayed on late without threatening the front
Settled behind the front group early - drifted into midfield past 4f - driven up to challenge 2f out with a shout in the finish - faded close home to finish 6th
Settled midfield early - nudged for effort with over 2f left - unable to find any advance - eventually finished seventh
Tracked pace early - hit front after 2 furlongs before losing command and driven when overtaken 2f out - faded final furlong to finish eighth
Went straight to front - lost command after 2f but stayed close up - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - driven from over 2f out but made no impact - finished tenth
Hesitant leaving the stalls - stayed at the back throughout - well held in 11th
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - no real impact made - finished well beaten in 12th
Handy in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left before hitting front inside final furlong - kept finding more and pulled clear near the finish
Tracked the front group early - driven approaching 2f out and kept on to fight for the runner-up spot - edged out in the closing yards for second
Settled midfield early - improved into contention over 2f out and challenged the front group with a furlong left - held pace to finish third one and a half lengths back

Held a midpack berth early - driven up to make ground approaching the final two furlongs then fought for fourth inside the last - lacked the speed to get on terms and finished fourth beaten under two lengths
Held up towards the back - driven 2f out and made gradual headway - unable to close further to finish 5th
Held handy on the wide side - asked for effort 2f out and slipped back a place - stayed on same gear final furlong to finish sixth beaten 2¼ lengths
Sent clear early - urged to keep advantage over 2f out - lost front spot inside final furlong under pressure - weakened close home to finish seventh
Held up in the pack - driven with 2f to go - stayed on without troubling the front runners - finished 8th
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - unable to improve position - finished ninth
Held up towards back - driven 2f out - unable to close - finished well held
Held up at the back - never got involved - finished well held in 11th
Held up in midfield towards the outside - urged forward approaching 3f out - under pressure and struggling into contention over 2f out - well held at the finish
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with over a furlong left - dropped away quickly a furlong out - beaten into 13th
Slow to break - settled midfield then found room and gained ground on the rails 2f out - urged forward but faded fast approaching the last furlong
Set the pace from the off - driven along 2f out and continued to battle - challenged in final strides and held on under pressure

Sat just behind the front group early - back in 6th at halfway - pushed along to make ground 2f out - fourth and driven with a furlong left - finished strongly to challenge late and go down by a short margin
Sat behind front group early - third at halfway then pushed along approaching 2f out to move into second - held effort through the closing stages to finish 3rd beaten a length and a half
Settled midfield early - pushed into 6th with 2f left and 5th soon after - stayed on at one gear through the finish to take 4th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - improved to close late - finished 5th beaten 2¼ lengths
Held up towards back - pushed along 2f out - finished strongly to close - eventually sixth
Settled off the pace - still towards the back at halfway - boxed in with 2 1/2f left - angled right and pushed along 2f out then finished well to close
Sat close to the pace - 4th at halfway - pushed forward to challenge 2f out - held 3rd but flattened out through the final furlong
Tracked the pack early - 7th at halfway - pushed along 3f from home - stayed on one-paced to finish 9th
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort 3f out and angled right approaching 2f out - stayed on late to finish 10th
Held up towards back - pushed along with 2f to go and eased over to the left inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to the line
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on same gear final furlong to finish 12th
Held a midpack spot early - pressed for effort with 3f left - unable to quicken from 2f out - finished well held in 13th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with no headway 2½f out - stayed on same gear late - finished 14th
Sat close up early - second at halfway before pressed into effort 3f out - held no more into the final stretch to finish well held
Sat close to the pace early - 5th at halfway - pressed for effort 3f out and unable to find more inside final 2f
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along without responding out wide 2f out - faded to finish well held in 17th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with no headway approaching 2f out - held no chance from there to finish well beaten
Handy up front early - driven to the front inside final 2f - quickly opened daylight - stayed on to score easily
Held up early - urged forward approaching final 2f - finished strongly inside last furlong to move into second close home - unable to match winner
Settled midfield early - asked for effort with over 2f left - up into third with over a furlong to run - kept going steadily to finish third
Raced behind the front group wide - driven up with over 2f left and kept going steadily - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Set the early pace - driven approaching final 2f then overtaken - dropped away meekly late to finish 5th
Held up at the back - urged into contention with 3f left - unable to make an impact - well held in 6th
Sat close to the leading duo early - asked for effort inside final 2f and faded fast - well held at the finish

Settled around midfield early - improved into 6th by halfway - moved up into 4th and eased across left with 2f left - pushed along into 3rd approaching the furlong pole - stayed on strongly to hit the front near the line and score comfortably

Set the pace from the start - pushed clear 2f out and opened a big gap over 1f out - stayed on well but caught in the closing strides - unable to find more - finished second beaten a length and a half
Sat close to the front group - 4th at halfway - pushed into 2nd spot with 2f left - unable to close late and held on for third
Slow to break - settled midfield - pushed along to challenge with 3f left but made no headway in 5th with a furlong and a half to go - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Keen to begin - settled midfield - moved left and asked for effort 2½f out but made no headway in 6th - stayed on same gear to finish 5th
Settled just off the front group - 5th at halfway - dropped back approaching 3f out - shaken up in 7th but unable to close 2f out and stayed on same tempo to the line
Sat close to pace early in 2nd - pushed along with 2f to go and dropped to 4th - one-paced through final furlong finishing 7th
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2 1/2f left but couldn't quicken - stayed on at the same rate to the line - finished 8th
Slow to begin and settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on at same effort inside final furlong - finished 9th
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with 2 1/2f left - unable to close from 2f out - eventually well held in 10th
Held up in the pack - pushed along and unable to close 2½f out - well held at the finish
Hesitant start at the back - urged forward and asked for effort 3f from home - unable to quicken over 1f out and well held late
Held up towards back - pushed along with no headway approaching final 3f - stayed on same speed to finish 13th
Sat close to pace - third at halfway - driven 3f out and unable to find more late - well held in 14th
Slow to start and settled at the rear - niggled into it from halfway - made no impact when pressure applied 3f out and finished well beaten
Held up at the back - pushed along with no headway 3f out - well held at the finish
Settled off the pace - pushed along with no headway approaching 3f out - dropped towards the back - well beaten at the finish
Held up at back of field - pushed along with no headway 3f out - well held at finish
Jumped smartly to the front - displaced after 2f and settled in behind - regained command over 1f out and forged ahead - kept on strongly to score with authority
Hesitant start - held up towards the back - driven into contention with 2f left - moved into second inside the final furlong but no answer for a dominant winner
Slow to break - settled behind leading two - driven with 2f left and unable to close finished third
Settled close up on rail early - hit front after 2f then driven when overtaken with over a furlong left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish fourth
Raced handy on the wide side - sat closer to the front pair before 2f gone - nudged for effort 2f out and stayed on same pace - finished fifth
Keen and unsettled early - dropped towards the back - fell away final furlong
Sat handy behind the front group - pushed along and hit the front with 1 1/2f left - stayed strong to the line for the win
Settled midfield early - pushed along and closed 2f out - up to 3rd with a furlong left - stayed on to just miss by a half length
Held up towards the back - pushed along and moved through on the outside 2f out - fourth with a furlong left before finishing well to grab third
Held up at back - headway two out but boxed in - forced into 5th a furlong out - stayed on to finish 4th beaten a length
Settled midpack early - pushed along for a run along the inner approaching final two furlongs and up to 6th with a furlong left - held effort to the line for 5th
Slow into stride and settled towards the back - pushed along to close in and briefly baulked with 2f left - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 3.25 lengths
Settled midpack - pushed along with 2 1/2f left - stayed on same gear through closing stages - finished 7th
Sat close to the front pack - pushed to challenge near the top around 1 1/2f out - couldn't find more in the closing stages - finished 8th
Sat close to the front pack early - pushed along into 2nd spot 2½f out - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished 9th
Settled midfield - squeezed for space and knocked about approaching 2f out - unable to threaten leaders then plugged on same speed to finish 10th
Held a midfield position - pushed along with 3f left but couldn't threaten leaders approaching final 2f - stayed on at the same rate to finish 11th
Settled midfield - pushed along wide 2f out - unable to close before finishing 12th beaten 7 lengths
Tracked front group early - pushed along and eased right with 2f left - unable to find extra - well held in 13th
Early into a forward position - shared the lead approaching 3f then pressed and lost command over 2f out - unable to find more after that and well held at the finish
Held up towards back of field - pushed along with no advance 2f out - stayed on same gear from final furlong - finished 15th
Among the pace early - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs and lost the front spot - unable to find more in the last furlong - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 3f left but made no headway - unable to find more inside final furlong - well held
Held up towards back - pushed along at halfway - unable to find more inside final 2f - well held in 18th
Held up midfield - pushed along and shifted wide with 2f left - unable to find more - well held at the finish
Slow to break and settled towards the back - pushed along early and asked for effort 3f out - unable to find more from 2f out and well held
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find more - well held in 21st
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort under two out - dropped away steadily - well held at the finish
Settled handy in the pack - urged forward with progress two out then third turning in - finished strongly to score

Sped clear at the outset - soon overtaken and tracked just behind the pace - urged forward with two furlongs left - edged back in front approaching the final furlong - driven out inside the last - kept going but caught close home - just denied at the line
Sat behind front group early - urged forward 2f out to gain ground - well placed and in with a shout under pressure a furlong out - held effort late but had nothing more to offer
Slow to break - held up in the pack - urged forward and made progress from over a furlong out - moved into fourth close home but never landed a blow on the front rank
Slow to break - settled towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out - stayed on without threatening the front runners
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final 2f - unable to gain ground - finished sixth
Slow to break - settled towards the back - driven with 2f out - stayed on without threatening finished 7th
Handy early - urged forward with 3f left - dropped away under pressure inside final 2f - eventually well held in 8th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward before 2f out - faded steadily to finish ninth
Went straight to front early - pushed along approaching final quarter mile - lost command inside final furlong and faded to finish
Held a midpack position early - urged for effort with 2f remaining - lost ground in closing stages - finished 11th
Held up in the pack - urged to quicken 2f out - found nothing under pressure - finished well beaten in 12th
Held handy on the outer - driven approaching 2f out - dropped away in the closing stages - finished 13th
Shared the front spot early - hit the front two out and pushed along - powered clear in the final furlong - won going away
Settled behind the front pack early - moved up wide after 3f - pressed for effort 2f out - up to 3rd inside final furlong - stayed on at one gear but unable to close on winner
Sat behind front pair early - well positioned by 3f mark - pushed along from 2f out and into 2nd - held effort through final furlong to finish third
Settled towards rear - boxed in for a moment 2f out - pushed along and finished strongly between rivals late to take 4th
Sat close to front early - drifted through the pack before being pressed for effort 2f out - moved into 5th with a furlong left - stayed on at an unchanged effort to the line
Sat close to the front group - pushed along 2f out and unable to find extra with a furlong and a half left - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left then edged forward inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Slow into stride and settled towards the back - pushed towards the wide side approaching 2f out and edged closer inside the final furlong and a half - stayed on same gear to finish 8th
Shared the early lead - pushed along and lost command 2f out - held 4th and unable to find more late finishing 9th
Sat close to the front early - drifted into the pack after 3f - pushed along 2f out then angled right approaching the last furlong - hampered for room - unable to find further response late
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with two furlongs left but couldn't threaten - held no more in hand approaching the final furlong - well held at the line
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left and edged forward wide entering final furlong - couldn't find more late and finished well held
Sluggish leaving the stalls and settled towards the back - pushed along but unable to close 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back for most of the way - pushed along but unable to close 2f out - finished well held in 14th
Slow to begin - travelled keenly up with the pace from the 3f marker - pushed along 2f out - flattened out inside final furlongs to finish well held
Held a midfield position - pressed for effort inside final 2f but couldn't quicken - finished well held
Settled in the pack towards the wide side - pushed along with no headway 2f out - held no more late - well held in 17th
Set the pace from the off - urged forward inside final furlong - kept finding under pressure - held clear to the line unopposed
Sat behind the front group early - urged forward passing the furlong marker - stayed on strongly through the closing stages to take second inside the final 110yds - unable to threaten the winner
Settled in the pack early - urged forward inside the final furlong and made gradual progress - crossed the line in third without threatening the front
Handy early - urged forward 2f out - stayed on same effort to finish 4th
Tracked the leading group - urged forward with over 2f left - stayed the pace before weakening close home
Held up towards the back - asked for effort inside final furlong - no impression made - finished 6th
Poor start and settled at back of field - stayed on past tired runners inside final furlong - finished seventh
Settled midfield early - urged for effort with over two furlongs left - lost ground final furlong - finished eighth beaten 7.75L
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to find any response - finished well held
Held up towards back - urged into effort over 2f out - unable to build momentum - finished well held in 10th
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward with two furlongs left - fell back rapidly through the closing stages - eventually finished 11th
Set the pace throughout - pushed along 2f out - opened a big margin inside final furlong - edged back a fraction over closing yards - stayed on strongly to win
Settled at back early - lost touch with leaders - moved across coming to 2f out and driven into contention - up into second inside final furlong - couldn't match winner's finishing speed
Sat close behind the front group early - pushed for effort with 2f left and pressed the eventual winner inside the final furlong - couldn't find more in the closing 150yds finishing third
Settled in the pack early - pushed along approaching 3f out and drifted left over 2f out - pressed on again inside final furlong but without the speed to threaten the front - finished 4th
Held up towards the back - denied room from 2f out - found space in the final furlong and stayed on without threatening
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed forward with three furlongs left - lost touch with the pace and needed more with a furlong to go - stayed on late but finished well adrift in 6th
Settled close to the pace - urged for effort with 2f left and unable to find more approaching the final furlong - dropped away late to finish seventh
Handy in the lead group early - pushed for effort with 2f left then bumped inside the final furlong - dropped away close home to finish eighth
Sat close to the pace on the wide side - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away final furlong plus - finished ninth
Held up in the pack - driven approaching 2f out and drifted right with a furlong left - unable to quicken back into 10th
Tracked the pace on the far rail - pushed along with 2f to run - edged into contention a furlong out - fought back to get up right on the line

Sat behind front pack near the stands rail - pushed along 2f out - shifted towards the middle and shared the advantage - went ahead a furlong out and stayed on - pegged back in the final strides for second
Held up towards the back near the far rail - pushed along with 2f left - responded to close into 6th before finishing on well
Sat close to the front on the wide flank - pushed along to challenge 2f out before losing the advantage inside final furlong - stayed on at an even effort to finish 4th beaten a length and a quarter
Sat close to the front on the near flank - pressed for effort 2f out and up to 4th with a furlong left - stayed on at one gear to the line finishing 5th
Tracked the pack on the far rail early - pushed along to narrow gap 2f out - unable to find more and stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Settled midfield on the far flank - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one gear through the final furlong - finished seventh
Slow into stride and settled towards the back - pressed for effort 2f out and hampered for room approaching final furlong and a half - stayed on inside the last to finish eighth
Slow to break - settled towards the rear on the far flank - pushed along and made no headway over 2f out then stayed on at one tempo late to finish 9th beaten 6 1/4 lengths
Settled midfield on the far flank - pressed for effort with two furlongs left but couldn't close on the front markers - stayed on at one gear to finish tenth
Sat close to the front bunch on the far rail - shifted to the middle at halfway - pushed along with 2f left - held on without gaining finishing 11th
Settled in the far flank bunch - pushed along and making no headway 2f out - plugged on at one speed final furlong to finish 12th
Held up towards the back on the far flank - pushed along but failed to threaten with two furlongs left - stayed on at the same rate from a furlong out - finished 13th beaten 9 lengths
Held up in the pack on the favoured flank - given a nudge along 2f out - never landed a blow to finish 14th
Sat close to the pace on the far flank - pressed for effort with 2f left but found little - eventually held in 15th
Settled behind the pace on the outer flank - pressed for effort at the halfway point - unable to find more inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 16th
Set the pace along one strip of the track - pressed for effort and lost command inside the final two furlongs - couldn't quicken again a furlong later - eventually beaten well into 17th
Settled just behind the pace on the wide flank - pushed along and unable to quicken from 2f out - eventually well held in 18th
Settled towards the rear on the wide flank - pushed along with two furlongs left but unable to close - finished well beaten in 19th
Settled midfield near the far rail - pushed along under pressure with no response inside final furlongs - eventually well held in 20th
Held a midfield spot toward the far rail early - pushed along under pressure with nothing left inside the final 2f - well held at the finish
Settled midfield away wide of the pack - pushed along and unable to quicken 2f out - well held at the finish

Settled at back early - moved into second spot 4th - clipped a fence 3 out - close up when jumping errant at 2 out - found extra to hit front last - eased down and edged off a true line inside final furlong to score
Raced with eagerness in front - edge narrowed two out and asked for effort - lost command at the last - drifted left inside final furlong and unable to reclaim spot - finished second

Settled prominently early under restraint - eased back to rear of four - pressed for effort approaching three out - still competitive two out - asked for more soon after - unable to quicken and finished third
Set the pace from the outset - pushed along over 2f out - edged ahead with closest rival a furlong out and battled on bravely - stayed in front by the narrowest of margins at the line
Sat close to the front pack - asked for effort 2f out - broke away with the winner inside the final furlong - fought on gamely but narrowly denied
Held up towards the back - driven and made headway 2f out - grabbed third close home but never able to reach the leading two
Settled in the pack early - driven into contention with 2f left - kept going at same effort inside final furlong - finished fourth
Settled midfield early - urged forward with over 2f left - kept going without threatening the front - finished 5th beaten 6 lengths
Hesitant start leaving to settle towards the back - asked for effort with 2f left and made modest gains - unable to challenge the leading pair late on
Settled around midfield - driven to keep tab over 2f out - unable to find any headway thereafter
Settled towards the back - made progress 2f out - then asked for effort and unable to land a blow - finished 8th
Held handy in the pack - nudged for effort with 2f left - found nothing - finished ninth beaten 7¾ lengths
Tracked leading group early - driven approaching 2f out but unable to match leading pair - dropped away final furlong
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away late - finished well beaten in 12th
Settled in the pack early - urged on with 3f left - lost touch and trailed off to finish well beaten
Held up at the back throughout - never able to challenge - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack near the stand rail - began to close from the outer with 2f left - pushed along approaching the final furlong - hit the front inside the last 110yds and pulled clear to score
Held up towards the back - short of space up the inner passing the furlong marker - closed strongly late to grab second close home
Held up towards the back - shifted across and improved final furlong - drifted left near the finish to grab third
Up with the near-rail bunch from the off - took charge of that pack after 1f and set the pace - pressed into submission inside the final 110yds and had nothing more to give
Well placed on the far rail - hit front approaching 3f out and asserted inside final furlong - drifted markedly right once overtaken close home - lost momentum through the line
Handy up wide early - moved into second inside final two furlongs under pressure - couldn't find more late and held for sixth
Settled towards the back away from the far rail - pushed along with 2f remaining - lost ground a furlong out - responded and stayed on inside final 110yds to finish seventh
Up with the front rank far out - driven over 1f out - faded to fourth in the cluster late - 8th
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back on the far flank - struggling for pace in the closing stages before fading in the final 110yds - ninth
Settled second early on the near rail - urged forward two out then lost place approaching the furlong marker - faded finishing tenth
Settled towards the back on the far flank - nudged into contention approaching final two furlongs - lost momentum inside the last 110 yards and dropped away to finish 11th
Handy near the near rail early - urged to close on the front group with 2f left - driven up the straight but only stayed on at one speed - finished 12th beaten 8.5 lengths
Held up handy near the rail early holding a strong grip - squeezed for space when trying to improve a furlong out - lost ground inside the final furlong - dropped away towards the line to finish 13th
Poor start and hesitant into stride - back of the field down one flank - lost touch before halfway - shaken up to make some late progress in the closing stages
Held up handy on the near flank - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually well held in 15th
Clear early advantage down the far rail - pressed for effort as rivals came alongside 3f out - dropped away gradually in the final furlong
Held up at back on the far flank - lacked the pace to go with rivals from a furlong out - fell away in the closing stages to finish well beaten
Up with the far-rail group - lost touch and under pressure from 1f out - faded to finish 18th
Went in front near the rail early - overtaken after a furlong - settled midpack soon after - urged on by halfway then faded from a furlong out to finish well beaten
Tracked the front group - travelling strongly with 2f left - pushed into the advantage inside the closing furlong and drove clear to score
Settled towards back - moved left for room over 2f out - asked for effort and lost touch a furlong out - fought back well to storm clear inside the last - just failed to overhaul winner in second
Tracked leaders on rail - driven approaching 2f out and responded to the finish - lacked the speed to get involved late
Handy in front rank - upped tempo to hit the front approaching 2f out - shaken up but overtaken soon after - lost momentum inside the last to finish fourth
Pulled hard - held up in the pack - urged forward 2f out and made gradual progress - kept on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Held a midfield spot early - pushed for effort with 2f left but couldn't chase down the front pack - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled at back of field - urged forward approaching 3f out - lost ground from 2f out to finish seventh
Went straight to front - shown the whip and lost command inside final furlong - couldn't quicken again and dropped away to finish 8th
Settled with the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away soon after - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the off - pushed along inside the final furlong and edged away - won going away with plenty in hand

Settled centrally in the pack early - moved forward wide 2f out - pushed into third with a furlong and a half left - up into second inside the final furlong - unable to close on the leader and held on for the runner-up spot
Sat close to the front early - 4th at halfway - moved into 3rd with 2f left - pushed along into 2nd approaching the final furlong and a half - dropped to 3rd and stuck on for the finish
Sat close up in 2nd early - pressed for effort with 2f left and unable to quicken - held 4th spot and stayed on same gear to the line finishing 4th
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along with 2f left made no further gain in 5th with a furlong to go - stayed on same gear to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left but unable to close - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close on the leaders late
Sat just behind the front group - third at halfway - pushed along with 2 1/2f left - unable to quicken and dropped away inside the final furlongs - finished well held in 8th
Held eagerly early - settled towards the back - travelling fine 2 out - pushed along with a clean leap to hit the front at the last and stayed on strongly

Settled off the pace early - travelling comfortably approaching 2 out - pushed along to close on the front group - stayed on well inside final furlong - moved into second close home but held to a length and a half
Handy up with pace early - close up 3 out - clipped it 2 out - kicked in front soon after - overtaken close home and edged back to third
Went straight to front - challenged into last stages before losing command after 2 out - dropped away approaching final flight
Traveled over-eager early - dropped away before the 6th after an untidy leap - beaten at the rear and eased out of contention before the 7th
Set the pace on the near flank - edged clear inside the last furlong - driven out and finished strongly
Fronted the far-rail bunch - drew away from rivals when asked a furlong out - battled to the line but worn down late
Settled midpack near the stands rail - moved through from the furlong marker to grab second inside the last - stayed on to round out third at the line
Held up in the pack racing wide - moved into a share of second inside the final furlong - stayed on well to finish fourth beaten 3¾ lengths
Handy near the front along the far rail - moved into second with a furlong left - edged back down to finish fifth close home
Hesitant start - held up towards back - pushed along and closed ground late to finish 6th

Sat handy in the middle early - eased across towards the stand rail - urged forward with 2f left then given a further squeeze inside the final furlong - stayed on at one gait to finish seventh beaten 5 lengths
Held up towards the back near the far rail - drifted left when pushed along with 1f left - stayed on at same effort through the closing stages - finished eighth beaten 5¼ lengths
Held up handy on the near flank - driven approaching final furlong - lost ground close home - finished ninth beaten six lengths
Settled in the pack near the stands rail - lost touch with rivals approaching the furlong marker - dropped away close home - finished 10th
Settled second early on far flank - drifted markedly right when dropping back a furlong out - faded fast in the closing stages to finish 11th
Held up handy on the near flank early - lost touch with the pace over a furlong out - dropped away fast in the closing stages to finish well held
Held up in the pack wide of centre - lost momentum inside final furlong - dropped away close home
Held up towards the back on the near flank - dropped away from the pack inside final furlong - well beaten in 14th
Held up at the back early - no real threat throughout - well held at the finish
